I'm actually the baby's mother. The doctors here noticed something when they examined my daughter - they said she has some kind of heart murmur that they can hear continuously. I'm really worried because I didn't get any prenatal care during my pregnancy.
I understand your concern, and I'm here to help you get some answers. Have the doctors mentioned if she has "bounding" pulses or if she is experiencing any trouble breathing?

No, they haven't mentioned anything about bounding pulses or breathing problems. She seems to be breathing okay as far as I can tell. They did say something about some bluish spots on her skin and that her eyes looked a little cloudy, but I don't really understand what that means.
